t: WTW Launches Via Retirement to Drive Wealth Business Growth
desc: Willis Towers Watson (WTW) has launched Via Retirement, a new U.S. platform designed to help retirees convert accumulated savings into sustainable retirement income. The platform combines personalized advice, technology, and investment/annuity options. WTW's Wealth business grew 2% organically in Q2 2026, supported by higher retirement-related work. Via Retirement could generate additional advisory fees and annuity-distribution revenues while deepening client relationships, though earnings contribution will depend on customer adoption.
